text: Don’t let your mind bully your body into believing it must carry the burden of its worries.b
Your mind is your instrument. Learn to be its master and not its slave.
No amount of anxiety makes any difference to anything that is going to happen.
Whatever is going to happen will happen, whether we worry or not.
Do what you can, with what you’ve got, where you are.
Surrender to what is. Let go of what was. Have faith in what will be.
Almost everything will work again if you unplug it for a few minutes, including you.
You don’t have to see the whole staircase, just take the first step.
Anxiety happens when you think you have to figure everything out all at once. Breathe. You’re strong. You got this.
If you want to conquer the anxiety of life, live in the moment, live in the breath.
Our anxiety does not come from thinking about the future, but from wanting to control it.
No need to hurry. No need to sparkle. No need to be anybody but oneself.
Feelings come and go like clouds in a windy sky. Conscious breathing is my anchor.
You have power over your mind—not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
Sometimes letting go is the best way to find peace.
Let whatever you do today be enough.
Breathe. Let go. And remind yourself that this very moment is the only one you know you have for sure.
The greatest weapon against stress is our ability to choose one thought over another.
Smile, breathe, and go slowly.
Difficult roads often lead to beautiful destinations.
Not everything that weighs you down is yours to carry.
When you’re feeling anxious, remember: It’s just a thought, and a thought can be changed.
Our anxiety does not empty tomorrow of its sorrows, but only empties today of its strengths.
Feel the fear and do it anyway.
Worry is like a rocking chair: It gives you something to do but never gets you anywhere.
Be gentle with yourself, you’re doing the best you can.
Worrying is praying for something you don’t want.
You don’t have to have it all figured out to move forward.
Every day brings a choice: to practice stress or to practice peace.
Anxiety is a beast we feed by giving it power.
The moment you stop trying to control everything is the moment you can finally breathe.
Just when the caterpillar thought the world was over, it became a butterfly.
Worrying is a waste of imagination.
